snippet.title: Forgotten Seas | 1.0 Launch Trailer | High Seas Survival Game
snippet.description:
Experience survival on the high seas! Build an armada of ships, build a base, do trading, treasure hunting and more!

Play now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168260/Forgotten_Seas/

Set sail in the mysterious Bermuda Void where the ocean stretches endlessly and dry land is a rare commodity.
